title: MPs question UK Palantir contracts after investigation reveals security concerns
summary: Journalists find Swiss government rejected company over fears US intelligence might gain access to sensitive data UK MPs have raised concerns about the government’s contracts with Palantir after an investigation published in Switzerland highlighted allegations about the suitability and security of its products. The investigation by the Zurich-based research collective WAV and the Swiss online magazine Republik details Palantir’s efforts , over the course of seven years, to sell its products to Swiss federal agencies.
